facts.business: Hemisphere Properties India Limited owns strategically located land assets across key metropolitan cities and is primarily engaged in unlocking value through monetisation, development, leasing, and other commercially viable opportunities.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter includes: 1) Provision for Stamp Duty Payable of Rs. 65,100 lacs (Rs. 651 crore) based on FY 2016-17 circle rates, with Rs. 63,980.21 lacs outstanding as of March 31, 2026, not re-assessed post mutations/conveyance deeds. 2) Non-recognition of Property Tax/Urban Land Tax liability for 53.04 acres Chennai land parcel. 3) Non-compliance with Independent Director appointment requirements under Companies Act and SEBI LODR; NSE/BSE imposed fines of Rs. 326.61 lacs. 4) Notice from Delhi Revenue Department for alleged short payment of stamp duty on share allotments (2021), representation filed. 5) Collector, Pune approved sale of Bopkhel land parcel on payment of premium of Rs. 130.56 crore, considered as inventory improvement.

key_risks: Regulatory & Policy Risk: Changes in Government policies, land regulations, taxation, environmental norms and delays in statutory approvals may affect timelines.
Land Title & Statutory Risk: Pending mutation, registration and other statutory formalities relating to certain land parcels may affect transaction timelines.
Land Use Approval Risk: Development and value realisation dependent upon land-use, zoning, layout and other statutory approvals.
Litigation Risk: Ongoing and potential litigation related to land titles, stamp duty, property tax, and regulatory compliance.
facts.related_party_note: Government of India (President of India through MoHUA) is promoter holding 51.12%. Funds received from GoI against allotment of preference shares: Rs. 130 crore (FY 2021-22), Rs. 50 crore (March 2025), Rs. 75 crore (September 2025). CPWD (GOI undertaking) provides land security/maintenance services; expenses booked on provision basis via utilization certificates as CPWD raises no GST invoices.
